issue.title: Refresh stale chezmoi home memory instruction shims
issue.description: Discovered while verifying the approved wait-resolution fix with just check-full on 2026-08-09. The gate passed fmt, keep-sorted, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, patch/stitch terminology, Symvision, and toobig, then failed SASE validation at init memory --check. Output says it would overwrite five chezmoi-managed home instruction files/provider shims: ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, and OPENCODE.md, each +2 -2. I did not run sase init memory because memory/provider shim regeneration requires explicit owner permission in the current conversation. Scope: with owner approval, run the memory initialization from the canonical clean source so the chezmoi home shims are refreshed, then verify sase validate / just check no longer fails this gate. This is not the closed bob-cli-specific task sase-f8 and not the completed snoozed-status edit sase-gr; those only mention similar drift as context.
